measuredBehavior.unwrap: Only LSLInteger,LSLFloat,LSLString unwrap; SDK key stays its key struct. SDK null String unwraps null.
measuredBehavior.numericWidening: C accepts Char; I accepts Char/Int32; F accepts Char/Int32/Single/Double. Unsupported numeric conversions throw ArgumentException; nonprimitive incompatible values throw InvalidCastException.
measuredBehavior.objectBacking: Public obj Object[] accepts every tested CLR/SDK payload; raw boxes/references retained, only three SDK scalars unwrap. Class value can preserve class/backing self-cycle.
measuredBehavior.faultOrdering: Wrapper validation precedes source List.Data; source Data access precedes backing Array cast; source index is evaluated before destination SetValue/null access. Nonpositive count still performs pre-loop validation.
measuredBehavior.partialMutation: Previously copied elements survive subsequent source bounds/destination bounds/type failures.
measuredBehavior.heap: Mutating existing backing through this helper leaves cached global/class-own ledgers unchanged, including Object[] cells whose current sizes change.
